notes.title: One Dev to Rule Them All
notes.notes: [p]Dear MiLords & MiLadies,[/p][p]   I wanted to highlight what's been happening behind the scenes since our last post, which was quite some time ago.[/p][p]   Right now, the MiLord team is made up of only one developer: me. Without more hands on the project, progress has naturally slowed as compared to before. That being said, I am still entirely committed to seeing MiLord through to the end. It's taking longer than anticipated, but I'm working to advance the game every week. I can't express how much your kindness, support, and patience mean to me; they are the reason I can keep going through the hardest times.[/p][p]   I'll keep posting updates whenever I have something noteworthy to present. Thank you for supporting MiLord along this adventure.[/p][p]   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/bf35b1c64e352cfe3a967865100b4500c8cf5d21.jpg"][/img](Yes, I almost forgot, there’s a goat on the team — apparently that already qualifies us as the G.O.A.T.s.)[/p][p]— The (currently very small) MiLord Team[/p]

notes.title: The First Month
notes.notes:
[h3]Milords and Miladies,[/h3]

Today marks one month since MiLord entered Early Access—and what a journey it’s been! We’ve learned a lot, grown even more, and thanks to you, we’ve made some real progress toward the kingdom we’ve always dreamed of building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/218c1be8035ca8ce47b12c3a9054357e9784a872.png[/img]
[i]Note: We don't have controller support. Yet...[/i]

From day one, you’ve stood by us, even when the game had its share of bugs, missing translations, and a story that felt more like a whisper than an epic. We heard your feedback loud and clear—and we’ve been working non-stop to fix and improve things.

[h3]Here’s where we stand:[/h3]

Most of the critical early bugs have been fixed. Even though there are still some exist, we're working on them to fix. And yes, we are aware that upgrading Village Center to Level 2 breaks it's functionality... 😅

The missing translations have been added. This wouldn't be possible without your help. We've inspected all the reported areas and fixed their problems. Some of these updates will be releasing tomorrow.

And, [i]we’re thrilled to say[/i] we’ve started working with [b]InEv Games[/b] to expand and enrich the narrative of MiLord.

For those who ask [i]"Who are they?"[/i]; They are a team that focuses on developing heavily narrative driven games. We've met with them during the first week of our release. We want to thank them and share the games they are currently developing:

[b]Kardiya: The Winds of Fate![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3189020/Kardiya_The_Winds_of_Fate/
[b]Livber: Smoke and Mirrors[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3700580/Livber_Smoke_and_Mirrors/

[h3]Stories, stories and more stories...[/h3]

We heard your feedback, and that’s why we’ve teamed up with InEv Games to bring deeper, richer narratives into MiLord. Here’s a glimpse at one of the storylines we’ve been working on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/81419898fdd878d0507faf26632811c3d963cb04.png[/img]

Of course, we didn’t stop at one. When we say we’re adding stories, we mean a lot of stories. Seriously, a significant number of decisions will be coming your way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/bebefa961903928a5055e35d855116ef4f42e007.png[/img]

Just a little FYI: we’ve already got 24 stories in the game right now and we’re aiming for 330 by the end of the month. Yes, you read that right. Three hundred and thirty. That’s not a typo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/17581ba583a7ce9d471db7b18826621028ae6da5.png[/img]

And no, we’re not stopping at stories. We know it’s not enough. That’s why we’re preparing a full lore behind the world of MiLord. Once the stories are in place, we’ll begin slowly integrating that deeper lore into the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/907416197ba762397ce2062157c81452ae7b6b37.png[/img]
[i]Note: That little white page at the top is a 61 page long pdf file 😅[/i]

So from our whole team: thank you for being here. Thank you for your trust, your feedback, and your patience as we continue crafting the kingdom you deserve. 

Before finishing the post, I would like to remind everybody who reads this post to hop on our Discord channel to keep in contact with us. We would like to develop MiLord together!

notes.title: Milord is Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

On this special day as we celebrate the launch of Milord, we want to extend our heartfelt thanks to all of you. Your interest, support, and kind words mean the world to us.

We are a small but passionate team, working day and night to improve Milord, refine the gameplay, and offer you an unforgettable experience. We're just at the beginning of this journey, but with your support, the road ahead feels bright and full of hope. 

We're aware of the bugs as well. Thanks to the reports you've shared especially in our #bug-report channel on Discord we're doing our best to fix them quickly and effectively. Your feedback is our biggest ally in making this game even better. :muscle:

In the near future, Milord will continue to grow with exciting updates and new content. We've embarked on a beautiful journey together, and it’s an honor to share it with you.

Thank you all, one by one. We’re so glad to have you with us!
Stay tuned, this is just the beginning. 

With love,
The iBright Team

notes.title: MiLord Launches Tonight at 10AM PDT!
notes.notes:
Dear community,

After a long and emotional journey, MiLord is finally launching tonight. We’re beyond excited, and more than anything, grateful to have had you by our side throughout this process.

When you enter the game, you’ll be greeted by a small note. In that note, we openly share something important: we are aware of the missing pieces. We’ve done our best to create a stable and enjoyable experience, but we know there’s still work to be done.

Especially when it comes to the story, we’ve laid down the basics but we also know it’s not enough yet. The good news is: we’re not going anywhere. We’ll keep improving and updating MiLord regularly, and with your support, we’ll take it much further.

If it weren’t for you, we wouldn’t have made it this far. Your support has been our motivation through everything. So tonight, when MiLord goes live, we hope you’ll be with us once again.

We’re open to all your thoughts and feedback. Our only goal is not to let you down.

Thank you for always being there.
We love you.

— The iBright Team

notes.title: Over 10,000 Wishlists!
notes.notes:
We’re incredibly excited to share that Milord has officially passed 10,000 wishlists! We're already at 11,700 and counting.

This means the world to our small team. Your support, your curiosity, and your belief in this strange little kingdom have been a constant source of motivation. Thank you for standing with us, and for helping Milord grow into something we’re proud to share.

Our Early Access journey is just beginning. We have a lot planned for the future; new features, stories, and ideas we can’t wait to bring to life. Every bit of feedback, every wishlist, every kind message helps shape what’s next.

From all of us:
Thank you for joining us. We’re building this with you.

-The Milord Team

notes.title: MiLord Launches on April 14!
notes.notes:
We’ve been developing MiLord full-time for quite a while now  and it’s finally happening! MiLord will be available on April 14.

We know there have been some delays and hiccups along the way. But hey, maybe that’s what being an indie studio is all about :’)

We’re well aware that many of you have been supporting us for a long time and have been patiently waiting for this moment. That’s why we’ve tried our best to deliver something truly worth your time. For us, April 14 is just the beginning. After launch, we’ll continue working non-stop, especially on the narrative side with weekly updates and new content.

Please keep in mind that MiLord will be released in Early Access. We've added all the core mechanics we originally planned, but there's still work to do particularly in the story department. That said, we've completed the full gameplay loop and the first major narrative arc (the Barony section), so we felt this was the right time to finally share the game with you.
With your feedback and support, we’re confident this journey will only get better  and together under the MiLord banner, we’ll keep building richer and better experiences.

Like many small indie teams, we truly rely on your support by purchasing the game and leaving kind reviews, you help us keep going. We’re just a couple of passionate folks trying to create something meaningful. And of course, with that comes some struggles. But our only goal is to get better every day and to give back to the people who believe in us.
Thank you for being here. It means the world to us.

With love

notes.title: MiLord Early Access Launch – A New Beginning!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The time has come! Our game is finally launching into Early Access on April 7!
Originally, we planned to launch on March 24, but we needed a little extra time to make sure everything was good to go. Sometimes, game development throws unexpected curveballs, and we wanted to take the right steps before release. We appreciate your patience, and we’re excited to finally share the game with you soon!

We’re a small indie team, and this project has been a huge part of our lives. Recently, we had a pretty big moment: after working together remotely for so long, we finally met in person for the first time. Turns 
out, we’re all real people and not just voices in a Discord call (who knew?).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/0e8161b6e1926f5b5b1f1efd923cfb8cabe876bc.jpg[/img]

We’ve heard the feedback on the story, and it matters to us. Narrative is an important part of the game, and we want to do better. During Early Access, we’ll be making changes with that in mind, taking a closer look at what works and what doesn’t. If you’d like to share your thoughts beyond reviews, our Discord is always open, we’re listening.

As for the game, if you played our demo, you’ll notice some changes; it's not a full transformation, but we’ve made meaningful improvements based on your feedback. Early Access is just the beginning, and 
we’re excited (and mildly terrified) to shape this game alongside you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/a6b9683d91585322ace031b48afeff07c6479f19.jpg[/img]

Thank you for being here with us. Seriously. Whether you’re here to support, critique, or just see if we’ll crash and burn, we appreciate you.

[b]See you on April 7![/b]

notes.title: Many Many Stuff So Much To Talk About
notes.notes:
[h1]What we did? [/h1]

It's been 3 months? Let's clean up the cobwebs and show you what we did to the court. The problem with the late post was we did so much stuff at the same time but never reached to the final on any of the fronts we really never had anything complete to share. We just finished everything pretty much at the same time so get ready, this one going to be a loooooong list. Oh, the update is out. You can try these things on the list.

[h1]Can you hear me?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/b59fa2b92775688c89e9a07172070b3eb8a90181.png[/img]

We know how much you liked (?) the sound of petitioners in the game. So we added more! Then fixed some of the placeholder ones. Now we have more ambient sounds and character sounds to get you into the mood for some ruling. Let us know what do you think about the new ones and now fixed old ones. 


[h3]I can't show you how it sounds. You can only hear it yourself. So go and try them out![/h3]

[h1]You would not believe your eyes! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/7ea062f7ec5d4c08652ae9b7f41b135b281b4c6f.png[/img]

Check out this map! Now you'll get to see more details in the world map. Clouds and the rain with the sound will make you feel like a King!! 

[h1]Better End Turn[/h1]

We decided to make end turns more into a place where you can plan out your next move by being able to reach your objectives, budget page and treasury and many more things easily. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/387951e28909e8e86305f3b087f4e098309210ed.png[/img]
[h3]Yes, you can click on coins.[/h3]

[h1]The Battle is Neigh. [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/6491b2bb615823cbf0d694f8fb579575d3981818.gif[/img]
[h3]Get it? Because there is a horse logo on the battle. Okay, I'll see myself out...[/h3]

New battle system is ready! It's still the basics right now in the demo but we're planning to make it more integrated to requests and map to give you a more unique battles. 

[h1]New Story New Me[/h1]

New storyline with much more crazy details is on the road. For now we wanted to give you more of the systematical changes we made than all the stories we wrote so that you can have a rough guess on what's to come! 

Story becoming more and more wild than it was. I hope you like reading. We're about to put Brandon Sanderson to shame with how elaborate it has become. Which needs your feedback a lot. We don't know how much better or worse it become without feedbacks. Which brings us to another point with the Early Access. 

[h1]What's the plan?[/h1]

We decided to go with Early Access. Why? Because we need more feedbacks. It's not like game is going to be unfinished. We can release this version as a full game and it wouldn't be an issue. When we have so much more stuff we can add to the game calling the game's release as a full release, we find it to be inconsiderate to you our players. We'll get more into the details before the release.

[h1]Steam Next Fest!!![/h1]

We are on the next Steam Next Fest!! We'll make a more in depth Next Fest details next week so look forward to that.

notes.title: Tokyo Game Show 2024
notes.notes:
From September 26–29, we attended Tokyo Game Show at the vibrant Makuhari Messe, Japan. It was our first time showcasing a game at such a massive global event, and we were thrilled to be one of the 80 indie studios selected to participate.

[h3]Presenting Milord, Presenting Türkiye[/h3]

For TGS, we knew we can’t come unprepared to the event, so our first priority was to add Japanese language to ensure our Japanese players felt right at home. For you to have the best experience, we polished the game, squished Milord’s bugs, brought turkish delight and other turkish sweets over 5000 miles and true to our Turkish roots, we couldn’t resist sharing a little treat with our indie booth neighbors.
Our biggest gift came from watching our players having fun playing Milord. Some ruled with grace even won in the end, and some… decided to cut a poor baby in half. I mean how could you?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/a643b37498cf3f4ef5b43430a4e0b09c730f73b1.jpg[/img]

[h3]An Unforgettable Community[/h3]

We were prepared for feedback, but everyone in the event opened their arms with kindness and extreme support from day one. Even during the first days of TGS, we had the chance to connect with other indie developers and publishers. Sharing our insights and experiences with all of them was a reminder that, no matter where we come from, we’re all united by games.
In past events, we were usually the only studio rolling in as a family, making us feel like the odd ones out. But at TGS, it was heartwarming to see so many families enjoying the event together. From parents introducing their kids to gaming to multi-generational groups wandering the halls. A big shoutout to our little iBright Games boss who was miraculous at Tokyo Game Show.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/b1092cf852c6f49964b55770e3b593fbc60ae92c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Looking Ahead...[/h3]

We’ve already started exploring new UI ideas to help you navigate Milord’s realm with ease (because managing a kingdom is already hard enough). Meanwhile, the story is getting more and more immersive—maybe it’s almost ready to unfold.
And don’t worry, your farmers won’t be pestering you about some ancient seed or rusty tools all the time now. More stories are on the horizon, and we can’t wait to see what kind of lord you become! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/471a717eafcc889928ffd34e164731a0986bde25.jpg[/img]

[i]And fore and foremost, a heartfelt thank you to everyone in the TGS community who visited our booth, played Milord, or simply stopped by to chat. Your support always means a lot to us, and we’re so excited to continue this journey with all of you![/i]

notes.title: Turn-Based Carnival
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/b729c57a05dfc0d11242d3e129d4e28d20e4bfb1.png[/img]

[h2]Milords and Miladies![/h2]

Yes, we’re back already—just a week after our last update! But we couldn’t resist sharing some exciting news. 

We’ve got another special announcement, and while it’s just the beginning of what’s coming, there’s plenty more to reveal soon!

[h2]Turn-Based Carnival Event[/h2]

MiLord will be part of the Turn-Based Carnival event! If you haven’t had a chance to try our demo yet, now’s the perfect time to dive in and share your feedback with us. 

It's always a great opportunity to see your reviews and feedback. Those are really drive us forward trough our game development.

[h2]What’s New?[/h2]

You might be wondering if we’ve added anything new to the demo for this event, specially right after another one...

Well, while we haven’t made any updates or changes to the demo version, we’ve been hard at work behind the scenes. 

[h2]Main Storyline[/h2]

We’ve officially kicked off the implementation of our main storyline! Yay!

Well there is a lot of questions in the mind even from now I believe...
So Let's dive into that right away!

[b]Will it be a linear story game?[/b] [b]No![/b] Main Story is just a part of our game-play, just like endless and dynamic ones. We'll be experiencing story while also dealing with our dynamically generated problems trough out our rule.

[b]How can we effect the story and progress?[/b] We have a lot of mechanics that enables us to change the direction of the story as you progress and make choices so everything will be effected by choices as always.

[b]Will I be able to create my own character and kingdom?[/b] [b]Yes![/b] You'll be starting the game with a screen where you can modify your Ruler, Kingdom name and Banners. So you'll be able to represent your family in the MiLord!

[b]How does the Progression works in the story?[/b] We'll be starting as the Baron in some Village in our desired Realm. Our main purpose will be the becoming a Count by completing the story-line. As we progress trough the game, we'll be ranking up in the world.

[b]Are there any differences in the Ranks?[/b] [b]Yes![/b] Each rank will have access more of the mechanics of the game. For example; while Baron can build new structures in his/her village, Count can build structures around the region and the Duke can found an entirely new settlements!

[b]When will we see these?[/b] Right now, we are solely focused on implementing the story-line. We don't want to jinx it but let's say as soon as possible!

In the upcoming posts, you can expect to see more sneak peeks of the narrative, characters, and events that will drive the core experience of our game. 

Thanks again for all your supports, and don't forget to follow us on Steam!

[h3]For now, Let's have fun with the Carnival! o/[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/75fdb17891f0d862ed95c894e0aa6be359851936.png[/img]

notes.title: Land of the Crescent
notes.notes:
[h2]Milords and Miladies![/h2]

Has it really been two months since our last news? So much has happened since then, and today we’ll reveal some part of it. The rest, well… let’s say it deserves a post of its own!

[h2]Land of the Crescent[/h2]

First and foremost, MiLord will be featured in the Land of the Crescent event starting on November 6!

What's the meaning of this for you? We'll have a public demo special for this event, Yay! 

We have fixed most of the bugs that we've faced during TGS 2024. [i](Which we'll discuss in detail for the upcoming posts)[/i] So it'll be more refined gameplay for you to test our mechanics. 
Be prepared for the Winter Battles! 

So, stay tuned and mark your calendars for 6th of November and join us at the Land of the Crescent!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/90d1ca63d468c84410e817a9490988404baea619.png[/img]


[h2]Translation Update[/h2]

What's waiting for you in this demo? Well, MiLord now can be playable in multiple languages, starting from Japanese and Turkish! Adding these languages is still experimental, and we've first released it to our Alpha players. Then, these new translations will also be available in the demo with the Land of the Crescent event. 

It’s exciting to bring MiLord closer to more players worldwide, and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts. Here is a sneak peak of how you can change the language in-game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/c94fdeb2080a6a95fa2c4acf977ffdd1959b1cd0.gif[/img]

[i]*We strongly suggest you to [u]not[/u] change it during an active gameplay for now... xD[/i]

[h2]Winter Demo Almost Completed[/h2]

Also we've almost completed the Winter Demo, so you can expect to have around 30-45 minutes of gameplay. Let's see if you can survive through out the winter, eh?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/8108aaf75b42ad37e8a50025e6f5e356efaf3920.gif[/img]


We have a lot more news to share with you, however, we wanted to separate them as a whole for another post, after the Land of the Crescent. 

So, before we finish, we would like to thank you for all your continued support during this time. And please don’t forget to [b]follow our Steam Page[/b] since we'll be informing you here more often now.

[h3]Let's meet at the Land of the Crescent! o/[/h3]

notes.title: Exploration Time!
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome back again Milords and Miladies[/h1]

[h2]Are you ready to seek out what's hidden in the forest of Riverra?[/h2]

[h3]With the brand new ''Exploration'' system, land is yours![/h3]



[h2]Send your brave scouts to find what is hidden in your lands or lands that are far far away to seek out trade partners and such. 
[/h2]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/144520829122772994/1251096268630130768/ExplorationV4.gif?ex=666d55b2&is=666c0432&hm=e8138e568a84625773eba22a1a0f4e54ad7b1b88af2492b51fbd04dad6cc470e&[/img]

[h3]Every place that players unlock will be different and will depend on luck. Every game will have different lands to offer. From barbarian forts and outlaw camps to abandoned farms and temples, anything is possible. [/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/3361a6b5915c287a9b6a3d71a5269462200814d3.png[/img]

[h3]Of course we'll get to influence the outcome of the explorations with our choices. Special requests tailored for the land that will be picked when you click to explore the land. Also how the land will end up will be by your choice. Positive or negative. 

[/h3]



We're really excited to announce this since from this mechanic we'll add even more content about outside the land from. Trade Cities to Land of Papacy there will be even more stories you can experience. If you have any questions or recommendations; 

You can comment here.
or
You can join our discord server and see sneak peaks before we talk about them here.

notes.title: It's cold outside
notes.notes:
[h2]THE WINTER IS COMI- Too Overused. [/h2]

notes.title: Milord Beta is Out!
notes.notes:
[h1]Milord Beta Test is out![/h1]

Milords and Miladies! We’re proud to present the Beta Test of Milord after… *Checks notes* 3 months? Woah, it’s been that long? We’ll make it a worthwhile for your wait. We’ll slowly take players in our Discord server. We would like to read your ideas and suggestions. 

Discord Invite Link: https://discord.gg/hR9EgwQnuD


[h1]Renaissance came to Milord early![/h1]

Hear Ye, Hear Ye! We have bunch of artistic and revolutionary new stuff for you to feast your eyes upon. This update will be on beta in next months.  I can easily say Renaissance is right now in Milord! We really hope you’ll like this months new updates as much as we enjoyed making them. Without further ado… 

[h1]New Characters![/h1]

It’s time to go east… To the land of our Pope’s fertile lands! He’s the one who controls all the Religions by an extention your churches in all the land. His cardinals and his priest will try to meddle on every choice you make. They have quite the power on people and you so they need to look like nobles but humble at the same time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/a2f0818f69ec8d313b9e982c8dbc3d3f862717d1.gif[/img]

[h3]Base of Nun and Priest. We'll add more accessories and make some little subtle changes.[/h3]

Now I introduce you to Diplomats! They do most of our dirty work and risk their lives to convey our feelings whether it’s kind or angry to other ruler. To show he’s not a danger he has to wear clothes that has a free feeling to it but still Show the regal look so we went with this. Let us know what do you think about them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/f813124eddcd27dc1f572200da44914c3cc1eeaf.gif[/img]

[h3]Diplomat in his full glory![/h3]
 
[h1]Artifact Quests![/h1]

You have a curious petitioner my liege! He wants to find the secrets of the World! Let’s help him find it! Maybe we can get something out of it? 
You can go on an adventure thanks to your people. They’ll search every corner of your lands to find it. But bear in mind you must be prepared to pay ample amount of golds to find it. 
Today’s Artifact Quest is about Saint Leo the Lawmaker!  His cross is somewhere in your lands! Can you find his holy item?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/c41676f6bfcd746d9e2bc42d697912dc4c670764.png[/img]

[h1]How to rule your Kingdom vol1 Second Edition[/h1]

Second and the last edition of the vol 1 of this mini series we finally add the last touches and now it’s fully integrated. Our councillor will help you trough the hardships of ruling. Follow evertyhing he says and you should be okay. Or you can try different paths and find out. 0.0

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/824763daeb0418397070bfd78366fb6fd375dade.png[/img]

[h3]As you can see now most of the parts are character animated to give the game more life-like feeling. We’ll use this character animations and create new character animations in next requests.[/h3]

That's all folks! 
Thank you for reading this month's dev diary! 
See you people in next month!

notes.title: Improvements and new Office
notes.notes:
[h1]Firm steps forward to the Demo![/h1]

Milords and Miladies! We're getting closer and closer to the demo, every week. As it’s getting ready, our team has been working to perfect the realm, from well-behaved guards to new systems to make it a more realistic experience for you. We would like you to witness some of the improvements and changes we made to the game.

[h2]Take a deep breath![/h2]
Guardians being told that they breathe way too deep and it's scaring petitioners. The guardians insist it’s for the lord/lady’s protection, but they have been warned against it. They took criticism in stride, so, guardians will remain their duties with cleaner character idle animations, keeping the court safe until the grand opening.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/64850354b7d11c6b484076049dfa52d7b8065f34.gif[/img]

In the early years of the Milord’s realm, guards were too hyperventilated, worrying their rulers. They’ve been training on diaphragmatic breathing so; the new rulers can be relaxed that their guards will be more than capable for the upcoming demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/b8ed6cdd83e1fa2f963e7c9119528ee429ada11e.gif[/img]

New character with its whole glory. The herald is yelling in the halls of the court: “A MAN WITH A BROWN HAT is here! A man with a brown hat is here, dear Milord. Shall we let him in? We shouldn’t keep him out in the cold in this snowy weather.

[h2]Ruler's Diary[/h2]
Our rulers kept forgetting where they left off on the story. Thanks to the invention of the handy dandy “save system”, rulers can save their progress and pick up where they left off. It's not a random usual save system. Customizing the save name, seeing all the vital information and adding a little picture of their court... all is possible.
What? Pictures weren't invented back then? Shh, don't let anyone tell you otherwise.

Rulers are feeling grateful for the invention; it allowed them to make it easier than ever to pass down their stories through generations and be remembered by history.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/1db7afcf40ebc08349e0bdb7595ea3fb201ff6ae.png[/img]

[h2]How to Run your Kingdom vol1 1st Edition.[/h2]
Are you having a problem ruling your Kingdom? All your subjects hate you? If so, you are not alone. It's one of the biggest problems of The Dark Ages. But fear not, today there is a solution to your woes -the tutorial system-. With the brand-new tutorial system, you'll know how to rule your kingdom faster. In the tutorial, you will gain the knowledge and skills needed to lead your kingdom into a new era of prosperity as an experienced ruler.

Also, the days of straining our voices and repeating "You're a lord of a kingdom" over and over again is gone. In the expos, now we can confidently showcase our game and let the tutorial do the job. So, the next time you see us at a game expo, don't hesitate to give "Milord" a try and we will be there as the strategy advisers, dear milord/milady!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/c41c6f5b1d8c1c18aa2464415f83e17ba1873506.gif[/img]

A requestline with many and many picks. It might seem like not much but there are so many ways you can do a single unimportant request. Which we call these requests a requestline. 

[h2]New Court New Adventures[/h2]
iBright Games has an official court! Our court is more than an office space. From the windows, you can see the busy city below and the iconic Galata Tower, standing as legendary as ever. Within these walls, our team will come together to elevate Milord to new heights. It will surely inspire us to make great improvements and games in the future. 
Additionally, we are grateful to the BUGLab TEKMER aka. our pathfinders, for their invaluable support and guidance in helping us with this process, we wouldn't have made it this far without them.

Link to their website: www.linkedin.com/company/buglabtekmer/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306977/6d0e3b48b7c97a1bb2e61ea6956c076caa0945c7.png[/img]

We hope you enjoyed reading them, as we enjoyed implementing them. And here comes the question: Where is the demo? Well, the demo went fishing and it'll be back when ready.
Jokes aside, we are continuously improving and thinking about new ideas to provide you the best experience & story before releasing it to broader audience. Believe us, it'll worth the wait, Milord/Milady!
Hope to see you again in our next DevLog!
